content_sections.heading: Project Engineer Vacancy Details (Post-wise)
content_sections.text: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Project Engineer post under the C-NARMADA project in the Civil Engineering Department.

content_sections.heading: Project Engineer Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Experience with Hydraulic and Hydrologic Modelling, GIS, Open Channel Flow experiments, MATLAB/Python, Flood modelling. One of the degrees from IIT/IISc.

rows.qualification_required: PhD in Civil Engineering with specialization in Water Resources Engineering. The percentage/grade points with respect to the academic qualification will be a minimum 60% or equivalent grade from graduation onwards and 55% or equivalent grade in class 10th and 12th.

content_sections.heading: Project Engineer Salary
content_sections.text: The appointment is for a duration of 6 months or the project completion date, whichever is earlier.

content_sections.heading: Project Engineer Selection Process
content_sections.text: Merely meeting the minimum eligibility criteria will not guarantee shortlisting and/or appointment. A higher cutoff level may be used. The Institute reserves all rights not to call an applicant for a selection test or not to fill up a position through this round of selection process without assigning any reason.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Project Engineer
content_sections.text: Visit the official application portal at http://recruitment.iitgn.ac.in/projectstaff/. Locate the notification for the C-NARMADA project under Professor Pranab Mohapatra. Fill out the online application form with all required academic and personal details. Ensure all percentage and grade criteria (minimum 60% from graduation onwards and 55% in class 10th and 12th) are met. Submit the application form on or before 14.10.2026.

content_sections.heading: Project Engineer Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The position is temporary and tied to the C-NARMADA project. The duration of the appointment is 6 months or up to the project completion date, whichever is earlier. Eligibility norms are based on Institute norms. The Institute reserves the right not to fill the position without assigning any reason. For any queries, contact Prof. Pranab Mohapatra at [email protected] .

faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment being conducted by IIT Gandhinagar?
faq.answer: IIT Gandhinagar has invited applications for the temporary position of Project Engineer for the C-NARMADA project under the Civil Engineering Department.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Project Engineer?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the Project Engineer position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for IIT Gandhinagar Project Engineer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application is 14.10.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the essential qualification required for the Project Engineer post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a PhD in Civil Engineering with a specialization in Water Resources Engineering, along with a minimum of 60% or equivalent grade from graduation onwards and 55% or equivalent grade in class 10th and 12th.

faq.question: Q5. What is the consolidated monthly remuneration for this post?
faq.answer: The consolidated monthly remuneration ranges from ₹ 60,000 to ₹ 1,25,000.

faq.question: Q6. What is the duration of the appointment?
faq.answer: The appointment is for 6 months or until the project completion date, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q7. Is there an application fee mentioned in the notification?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I apply online for this vacancy?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through the official recruitment portal at http://recruitment.iitgn.ac.in/projectstaff/.
